color-contrast.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
ex: a[data-k="home"] > span :: Fix any of the following:   Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.17 (foreground color: #e8edf6, background color: #ffffff, font size: 12.8pt (17px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

a[data-k="learn"] > span :: Fix any of the following:   Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.61 (foreground color: #2fd4c4, background color: #ddf4f1, font size: 12.8pt (17px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

heading-order.help: Heading levels should only increase by one
ex: button[data-h="hold:h1"] > h4 :: Fix any of the following:   Heading order invalid

page-has-heading-one.help: Page should contain a level-one heading
ex: html :: Fix all of the following:   Page must have a level-one heading
